dct_description_sm: Data is not available for all days for all variables. Unavailable data is marked with an NA. Other data may be incorrect due to equipment failure or other problems. These are replaced by ERR. To see the complete data set please view weather_daily summaries complete.

These files contain daily weather and temperature data collected at QUBS Point, Queen's University Biological Station (18T 0394774 4935427), between January 1 and December 31 each year (1993-2010). Variables included are air temperature (mean, max, min, time at max, time at min); soil temperature (mean, max, min, time at max, time at min); and water temperature of Lake Opinicon at depths of 0.2m, 2.2m and 3.3m (mean, max, min, time at max, time at min for all).
